They simplify considerably when the original acid concentration is not too small and the ioniza- tion constants Ka1 and Ka2 differ substantially in magnitude (by a factor of 100 or more). The latter condition is almost always satisfied. Under such conditions, the two equilibria can be treated sequentially, as in the following example.
